clauses.scope_note: Grants a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free, perpetual (subject to Section 5) license to use, copy, modify, prepare derivative works, reproduce, and distribute the Licensed Work. The grant is limited to Peaceful Purpose and subject to the license; Sections 3 and 4 impose further conditions and restrictions.
clauses.condition_explanation: peaceful_purpose means the use meets the definition in Section 1.5; comply_with_license includes applicable license terms, including attribution, notice, propagation, and prohibited-use provisions.

clauses.scope_note: Grants a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free patent license to make, have made, use, offer to sell, sell, import, and otherwise transfer the Licensed Work, only for Peaceful Purpose and subject to the license. The allowed activity labels capture use and sale; the text also expressly covers making, import, and transfer.
clauses.condition_explanation: peaceful_purpose has the definition in Section 1.5; comply_with_license means applicable license terms remain in force and are followed.

clauses.scope_note: Defensive use is permitted without additional fees or restrictions, provided the Licensee can demonstrate upon reasonable request that the use is primarily defensive. This does not state that the separate Peace Clause prohibitions are waived.
clauses.condition_explanation: defensive_purpose has the definition in Section 1.6; demonstrable_upon_reasonable_request means the Licensee must be able to demonstrate the primarily defensive nature if reasonably asked.

clauses.scope_note: Commercial Use of the Licensed Work is permitted only when it constitutes a Peaceful Purpose and complies with all other license terms. Commercial Use is defined in Section 1.9 as use connected with an activity, product, or service from which the Licensee derives direct or indirect monetary revenue or commercial advantage.
clauses.condition_explanation: peaceful_purpose is defined in Section 1.5; comply_with_license requires compliance with other applicable terms, including Sections 3 and 4.

clauses.scope_note: The Licensee must retain notices and attribution statements in the Licensed Work; provide reasonable Licensor attribution in any Derivative Work or product incorporating the Licensed Work; and indicate whether modifications were made. The clause does not itself require distribution.
clauses.condition_explanation: The derivative/product attribution and modification-indication requirements apply when a Derivative Work or incorporating product is made; retaining notices applies to the Licensed Work.

clauses.scope_note: When the Licensee distributes a Derivative Work, it must make that work available under this License or a license with substantially equivalent peace-related terms, and Section 4 must propagate to all Derivative Works.
clauses.condition_explanation: derivative_work_distributed is the stated trigger; the two licensing formulations are alternatives.

clauses.scope_note: The Licensee must include a copy of, or URI reference to, this License with every distributed copy or substantial portion of the Licensed Work.
clauses.condition_explanation: The obligation is triggered by distribution of a copy or substantial portion of the Licensed Work.

clauses.scope_note: Prohibits using the Licensor’s or Licensed Work’s name, trademarks, or other identifiers to endorse or promote products derived from the Licensed Work without specific prior written permission.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies to endorsement or promotion of derived products using the specified identifiers; specific prior written permission is the stated exception.

clauses.scope_note: For deployment in a system making decisions affecting individual human rights or welfare, the Licensee must make reasonable efforts to ensure the use is transparent, explainable, and subject to human oversight.
clauses.condition_explanation: The trigger is deployment in a decision-making system affecting individual human rights or welfare; the required standard is reasonable efforts.

clauses.scope_note: The Licensee may not engage in the listed uses directly or indirectly, including through intermediaries. The armed-aggression prohibition expressly excepts lawful self-defense under international law. Autonomous lethal decision-making is prohibited only without meaningful human oversight and control, defined here as a qualified human decision-maker with sufficient time, information, and authority to prevent or countermand lethal action. Civilian targeting is covered where civilians or civilian infrastructure not serving a military purpose are primary or intended targets.
clauses.condition_explanation: Each listed use is a separate prohibited circumstance. The armed-aggression exception is lawful self-defense under international law. Other stated qualifications include the specified purpose for mass surveillance, direct suppression of the enumerated rights, severe and widespread environmental destruction with primary intent or known substantial likelihood, and use to facilitate the listed labor or trafficking abuses.

clauses.scope_note: Offensive Military Purpose is not covered by the free Section 2 grant and requires a separate paid commercial license agreement with the Licensor. The text says such agreement shall include specified requirements, but does not grant permission under that separate agreement or supply its terms or pricing.
clauses.condition_explanation: offensive_military_purpose is defined in Section 1.7. The free grant does not cover it; any separate paid agreement is determined by the Licensor and must include the listed certification, prohibition, reporting, and termination terms.

clauses.scope_note: Any use of the Licensed Work in violation of Section 4 automatically terminates the Licensee’s rights under this License.
clauses.condition_explanation: The trigger is any use violating the Peace Clause in Section 4.

clauses.scope_note: Rights terminated under Section 6.1 may be restored only if all stated cure requirements are met and the Licensor accepts the cure in its reasonable discretion. Restoration is not automatic upon stopping the violation or giving notice.
clauses.condition_explanation: The cure period and notice obligations apply after termination under Section 6.1. All three requirements are cumulative.

coverage_notes: The Licensed Work is defined broadly to include software, documentation, creative works, datasets, models, and other intellectual property made available under the License; the supplied text does not identify a particular repository artifact.

Sections 5.3–5.4 impose commitments on the Licensor concerning allocation and publication of information about Offensive Military Licenses, not ASC duties of the Licensee, so they are not extracted as Licensee clauses.
The text contains no express source-provision, training-specific, network-service, sublicensing, or output-rights clause. Those permissions or duties are not inferred from general wording or silence.
Section 6.3 concerns remedies and Section 6.4–6.5 standing and waiver; they do not specify ASC permissions or duties for the activities requested.
The disclaimer and liability provisions are omitted as unrelated to the requested ASC activities.
